settings.heading: Fit & fabric
settings.body: Cut oversized and boxy. 480gsm loopback cotton, garment-dyed then washed. Size down one for a standard fit.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.body: Canada 3–7 business days, US 5–10. Unworn pieces with tags can be returned within 30 days.

settings.heading: Care
settings.body: Cold wash inside out. Hang to dry. The washed finish is meant to fade further with wear.
